notes: TBox expansion paired with history-replace-0005 (Roman amphitheatre: gladiatorial combat -> chariot racing). Keeps the relation built_for and the new object chariot racing. The subject is a made-up class, the Tarvonian arenas, a newly identified kind of Roman public venue.
